status: Qualified native CUDA grouped output projection primitive and same-stream attention composition. Full native model forward/controller admission and vLLM parity remain open.

implementation.geometry: Generic groups1..64, positive K/N, rows1..16384. Actual checkpoint G8 K4096 N1024, down8192->5120.
implementation.layout: One immutable packed[K,G*N] group weight. Eight independent GEMMs retain weight leading dimension G*N and write F16 directly into disjoint columns of down.x[rows,G*N]. Existing down linear emits F16/F32. No weight duplication, group-output scratch or concatenation kernel/copy, for prefill and decode.
implementation.arithmetic: Group GEMMs use FP32 accumulation with F16 intermediate rounding. F16 down uses existing native32MiB cuBLAS handle; F32 down uses existing16MiB source-policy handle.
implementation.ownership: Backend owns immutable weight handles; caller request owns activations and reserved48MiB linear workspace. No allocations, transfers, internal fences or position/ring commits in operation.
implementation.preflight: Validate all dimensions, handles, types, exact view counts, alignment, request identity, reserved workspace and activation disjointness before any enqueue. Failed GEMMs mark request failed.

references.method: Unchanged original grouped projection and LinearFP16.forward AST. F16 original torch.matmul; F32 original hgemm.cu argument/workspace policy replay, not compiled full PyTorch extension. System cuBLAS13.10.
references.synthetic: All40 layers with actual immutable packed checkpoint WoA/WoB; rows1/4/32/273; F16/F32 outputs.
references.checkpoint_derived: 28 independently captured attention outputs, two output dtypes. Parent histories repeat canonical checkpoint values and use synthetic causal IDs; not a full-prefix forward.

open_work: Full native attention/controller/Engram/forward integration and admission
Matched vLLM prefill and decode within5%
Expert offload, serving and backend qualification in broader goal

qualification.clean_build: Zero warnings; standard suite, full CUDA suite, BF16 diagnostics and diagnostic isolation passed.
qualification.sanitizers: Normal, ASAN/UBSAN C probe, CUDA memcheck with full leak check, and initcheck passed all1504 projection and224 combined calls.
qualification.asan_scope: C probes, inline workspace planner and JSON module; CUDA host validation TU not ASAN instrumented
qualification.race: 96 bounded dyadic unit calls; actual checkpoint normal/ASAN/memcheck/initcheck, no full-checkpoint race run; zero hazards.
qualification.unit: 96 exact dyadic calls,434576 output words, malformed preflight/request/guard checks.
qualification.legacy_attention: 160 independent synthetic/checkpoint attention calls passed with final objects.
qualification.references: 5575 unique payloads across7 parent manifests hash-audited. Independent golden values preserved.
qualification.qwen27: Fresh strict CUDA gate:192/192 continuation IDs,8/8 first-token IDs; equal token counts.
qualification.harness_correction: First qualification stopped before GPU execution for compiler path-truncation warning in external combined probe. Dynamic path construction corrected; final probes zero warnings. Runtime/goldens unchanged.

prefill.scope: One warmed real callback on request stream:9 GEMM kernels and9 cuBLAS split-K reductions. Sole fence is caller completion, outside primitive. Profiled time only; no source/vLLM comparison.

decode.scope: One warmed real callback on request stream:9 GEMM kernels and9 cuBLAS split-K reductions. Sole fence is caller completion, outside primitive. Profiled time only; no source/vLLM comparison.

traces.comparison: Single profiled callback timings are not a source or vLLM parity benchmark.
